parse_requirements_file: parse a requirements.txt file and return a list of package dependencies with or without version specs
get_package_version: get the package version string by reading and executing the version.py file
add_mim_extension: add MIM extension files by creating symlinks or copies of tools, configs, and index files
install_editable_mode: install the sapiens_seg package in editable mode with pip install -e . to support MIM
build_source_distribution: build a source distribution or wheel of the sapiens_seg package using setup.py sdist or bdist_wheel
